description: Create foundation utilities: unified API Supabase client factory, status badge components and utilities, and API route wrapper for common patterns. This eliminates ~450 lines of duplicate API boilerplate and 120+ lines of status badge ternary chains.
steps: Create lib/supabase/api-client.ts with createApiClient() factory function that accepts useServiceRole option
Update app/api/complaints/route.ts to use createApiClient() instead of direct createClient(URL, KEY)
Update app/api/complaints/status/route.ts to use createApiClient()
Update app/api/consultations/route.ts to replace mixed client usage with createApiClient()
Update app/api/partnerships/route.ts to use createApiClient()
Create lib/utils/status-config.ts with getStatusConfig() and getPriorityConfig() utilities, defining all status/priority variants (contact, inquiry, complaint, consultation, lead, deal, partnership)
Create components/ui/status-badge.tsx component using status-config utility
Create components/ui/priority-badge.tsx component using status-config utility
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/contacts/page.tsx to replace inline status badge ternary chains with <StatusBadge> component (2 locations: desktop + mobile)
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/complaints/page.tsx to replace status and priority badge ternaries with components (4 locations total)
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/inquiries/page.tsx to remove getStatusConfig helper and use <StatusBadge> component
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/crm/leads/page.tsx to use <StatusBadge> component (2 locations)
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/crm/leads/[id]/page.tsx to use <StatusBadge>
Update app/contact/contact-client.tsx to use <StatusBadge>
Create lib/api/route-wrapper.ts with withApiHandler() HOF for common API patterns (rate limit, CAPTCHA, validation, error handling)
Create withGetHandler() simplified wrapper in lib/api/route-wrapper.ts for GET routes
Refactor app/api/contacts/route.ts POST handler to use withApiHandler, removing duplicate try-catch-ZodError pattern
Refactor app/api/inquiries/route.ts POST handler to use withApiHandler
Refactor app/api/newsletter/route.ts POST handler to use withApiHandler
Refactor app/api/contacts/route.ts GET handler to use withGetHandler
Refactor app/api/inquiries/route.ts GET handler to use withGetHandler
acceptance_criteria: All API routes using direct createClient(URL, KEY) now use createApiClient()
All status/priority badges across admin pages render using <StatusBadge> or <PriorityBadge> components
At least 5 API routes refactored to use withApiHandler wrapper
Manual test: submit contact form, verify success and error handling work
Manual test: visit admin/contacts, admin/complaints, admin/inquiries - verify badges render correctly
verification: Manual testing: Submit contact form at localhost:3000/contact, verify API response
Manual testing: Visit localhost:3000/admin/contacts, verify status badges display correctly
Manual testing: Visit localhost:3000/admin/complaints, verify status and priority badges
Manual testing: Visit localhost:3000/admin/inquiries, verify status badges
Grep check: grep -r 'createClient.*SUPABASE_URL.*ANON_KEY' app/api/ should return fewer results
